schema_version.description: Configuration schema version. Only 1 is supported.

project.description: The LaTeX project to convert. Treated as read-only.

root.description: Project root directory, relative to the directory of this configuration file. Default: '.'.

main.description: Main .tex file, relative to the project root; must stay inside it.

profile.description: Identifier of the conversion profile (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens).

profile_dirs.description: Extra directories searched for '<profile>.yaml' before the built-in profiles; relative to this configuration file.

bibliography.description: Bibliography settings; each key overrides the resolved profile.

files.description: Bibliography files relative to the project root (must stay inside it); replaces the files named by the source.

csl.description: CSL style file; relative to this configuration file, or absolute.

timeout_s.description: Timeout in seconds for each external command. Default: 120.

root.description: Workspace directory, relative to the project root. Default: '.latex2word'.

keep_on_failure.description: Keep the workspace when a run fails. Default: true.

directory.description: Output directory, relative to the project root. Default: 'output'.

filename.description: Output DOCX file name inside the output directory. Default: '<main file stem>.docx'.

fail_on.description: Lowest finding severity that fails a run. Default: 'error'.

tex.description: Explicit user decisions about LaTeX constructs the converter does not understand. By default an unknown command that carries text is an error (its text would be lost); listing it here accepts that loss for this project.

staging.description: Optional extra files to stage besides the reachable source dependencies.

extra_files.description: Files relative to the project root (must exist and stay inside it); staged byte-for-byte.

render_preamble.description: Extra LaTeX lines appended to the derived TikZ/circuitikz render preamble.

patches.description: Project-specific literal replacements applied to extracted TikZ source before rendering.

figure.description: Figure id the patch applies to.

pdf_backends.description: PDF to SVG backend candidates in order of preference.
